tasks.label: ROS: Build workspace
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.bash && if [ -f ../su17_experiment/devel/setup.bash ]; then source ../su17_experiment/devel/setup.bash; fi && if [ ! -e src/CMakeLists.txt ]; then catkin_init_workspace src; fi && catkin_make -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON

tasks.label: ROS: Build competition package
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.bash && if [ -f ../su17_experiment/devel/setup.bash ]; then source ../su17_experiment/devel/setup.bash; fi && if [ ! -e src/CMakeLists.txt ]; then catkin_init_workspace src; fi && catkin_make --only-pkg-with-deps su17_mission_planning -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON

tasks.label: ROS: Run mission planner
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.bash && source devel/setup.bash && roslaunch su17_mission_planning mission_planner.launch
